snippet.title: SHUNYA | Official Gameplay Trailer | Ronci
snippet.description:
Patient #17 has awakened.

Deep beneath a forgotten medical facility, a classified experiment has gone horribly wrong. Every failed subject was erased... until now.

Play as Patient #17, a survivor haunted by fragments of memories from those who came before. Sneak through abandoned corridors, uncover the facility's darkest secrets, evade the relentless Janitor, and escape before you become the next forgotten patient.

Will you uncover the truth behind Project Shunya... or become another failed experiment?

🎮 Follow SHUNYA on itch.io :
https://ronci.itch.io/shunya 
Releasing on 24 July 2026 -- (10 Day Build Available on page)

Features

Psychological & survival horror
Stealth-based gameplay
Explore a secret underground medical facility
Uncover hidden documents and experiment logs
Escape the relentless Janitor
Discover the fate of previous patients

Developed by Ronci Games
